reason: The hypothesis makes specific claims about the effect of HVAF-i7 parameters on deposition efficiency, oxidation, and coating thickness for FeCoNiCrAl feedstock, but no cited evidence is provided to support any of these premises. The proposal relies entirely on uncited assertions.
premises: Fine (5–30 μm) FeCoNiCrAl feedstock can be deposited by HVAF-i7 to form a dense, low-porosity coating
The specified HVAF-i7 parameters (propylene, 63 mm 3L4 nozzle, 2.75 mm injector, medium air/fuel) reduce in-flight oxidation and increase deposition efficiency
Reduced in-flight oxidation and higher deposition efficiency will overcome the thickness limitation seen with 15–45 μm feedstock
The resulting dense coating will form a protective, predominantly Al2O3 TGO during 1000–1150 °C oxidation
